theme_strategy.description: A high-end, immersive, and modern event landing page mixed with a comprehensive multi-role SaaS dashboard. Avoids generic AI templates. Focuses on cinematic lighting, glassmorphism, smooth animations, and high contrast typography.

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter leading-none

typography.guidelines: No Inter or Roboto. Use Clash Display for impactful, modern headers. Body text must be Manrope for extreme legibility in dashboard density. Always add tracking-tight to headings.

glassmorphism_tokens.card_heavy: bg-[#18245a]/20 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-2xl
glassmorphism_tokens.card_light: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/5 rounded-xl transition-all hover:bg-white/10

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8
spacing_and_layout.guidelines: Generous spacing. Break symmetry. Use bento grid patterns for event features. Always pad containers with borders. For dashboards, use tight gaps (gap-4) and strictly maximize screen real estate.

motion_guidelines.smooth_appear: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 30 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
motion_guidelines.guidelines: All page entrances must fade in and slide up smoothly. Do not over-animate; stick to elegant transitions. Use smooth scrolling (Lenis style if possible).

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-background font-semibold px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-primary_hover transition-colors shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(40,185,252,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white px-8 py-4 rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors

components.cards: Never use pure white backgrounds. Use glass_bg tokens. Apply glowing borders on hover.
components.shadcn_overrides: Customize Shadcn UI to fit dark theme. Remove Vercel-like sharp edges, use rounded-xl or rounded-2xl. Dialogs and Modals MUST use glassmorphism backgrounds.

pages_and_features.name: Landing Page
sections: Hero: Full viewport. Background image provided by user with a radial or linear black/gradient overlay (max bg-black/60). Headline 'Ozoxx Experience', subheadline, and a highly visible Countdown timer to Oct 8, 2025. Primary CTA 'Garantir Ingresso'.
Marquee: Infinite scrolling text ribbon reading 'OZOXX EXPERIENCE SÃO PAULO 2025' separated by dots or stars.
Event Details (Bento Grid): Dates (08 e 09 de Outubro), Location (São Paulo), Description of the immersive experience.
Gallery: Masonry or horizontal scroll of event/concert networking images.
Tickets/Pricing: Cards showing Single Ticket and Ticket + Companion. Clear pricing, benefits, and 'Comprar Agora' CTA.
FAQ & Footer: Clean accordion for FAQs. Large footer with links.

pages_and_features.name: Auth & Registration
features: Checkout flow: Collect user info, optional companion info, payment integration (PagBank).
Must support creating 2 credentials if companion is included.

pages_and_features.name: Participant Dashboard
features: Digital Credential Card: A beautiful, glassmorphic ID card layout featuring the user's name, ticket type, and a large QR Code.
Options to Download PDF or retry payment if failed.

pages_and_features.name: Admin Dashboard
pages_and_features.layout: Sidebar navigation (lucide-react icons). High density data tables.
features: Appearance: Form to update logo URL, landing page text, colors.
Users & Roles: Table managing (admin, comercial, financeiro, credenciadora).
Orders & Payments: Monitor transactions, PagBank statuses.
Settings: Configure API keys, event dates, location details.

pages_and_features.name: Scanner App (Credenciadora)
features: Uses camera to scan QR Codes from credentials.
Displays Success (Valid) or Error (Invalid/Already Checked-in) overlay.

testing_requirements: All interactive elements, forms, and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='checkout-submit-button').
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set up Tailwind config with custom colors and fonts (Clash Display & Manrope). 2. Build landing page with framer-motion for smooth reveal. 3. Ensure hero image has proper overlay for text contrast. 4. Build hybrid app routing (public vs protected dashboards). 5. Customize shadcn components to remove generic look. 6. Implement QR code component for credentials.
